root_energies_and_gradients.scope: Uniform-weight shared-QE-unitary ADAPT and native mean-root A-CASE on frozen small N/Sz sectors; local optimizer trajectories, not global optimality.

screening_and_optimizer_ledgers.scope: Observed complete-pool screens, retained distinct optimizer calls, callback/cache requests, and bank-pair creation; separate currencies, not a shot or total-cost estimate.

generic_circuit_bounds.scope: Commuting-QE Pauli parity-ladder bounds for MORE ansatzes, explicit two-quadrature reference fanouts for its root transitions, and independent local Pauli readouts for A-CASE; no optimized circuits, shot price or measured device cost.

wall_time_and_rss.scope: One fresh interpreter per cell, including preparation and instrumentation; single-host observations, not intrinsic row allocation or universal bounds.
